use Raster

let order = 23
let step = 1.0D

word(order: int) -> string =>
    (let previous mut = "1"
     let current mut = "0"

     for _ in 2..order do
         let next = "{current}{previous}"

         previous = current
         current = next
     od

     current)

let letters = word(order)

let image = IMAGE(450, 620)
let pen = TURTLE(image)

image.view(0.0D, 0.0D, 450.0D, 620.0D)
image.colour(0ub, 0ub, 160ub)
image.stroke(1.0D)

pen.move_to(21.0D, 600.0D)

for at in 0..letters.length do
    pen.forward(step)

    if letters[at] == '0' then
        pen.turn(if at % 2 == 1 then 90.0D else -90.0D fi)
    fi
od

image.write("fibonacci.png")

image.show("fibonacci.png")
